plan.summary: Three independent feature modules add the tab title, header date, and footer tag count through the existing feature/slot contract; a final integration test depends on all three and owns only a new test file, so concurrent lanes have disjoint write globs.

tasks.title: Add open-task count to browser tab title
tasks.goal: Create a new feature folder `src/features/open-count-title` that exports a `defineFeature` module. Read the existing `item-count` feature and feature contract, then subscribe to the `TodoStore` through `FeatureContext`. On boot and after every store change, count todos that are not completed and set `document.title` to a stable label such as `${openCount} open — Sky Todo`, keeping the exact format asserted by the feature test. Preserve cleanup/unsubscribe behavior according to the existing feature lifecycle. Do not edit shared registry, render, slot, store, or main-app files.
deliverables: A `document.title` updater that reacts to todo additions and completions
`src/features/open-count-title/index.test.ts` covering initial and updated open counts
definitionOfDone: New test mounts the feature with 3 open and 1 completed todo and asserts `document.title` contains `3 open` and not `4 open`
Same test completes one open todo and adds one open todo, then asserts the title recomputes back to `3 open`

tasks.title: Render today's date in the app header
tasks.goal: Create a new feature folder `src/features/header-date` that exports a `defineFeature` module and mounts a `<time>` element into the documented header slot exposed by `SLOT_NAMES`. Use an exported pure helper `formatHeaderDate(now: Date)` backed by `src/lib/dates.ts` so tests can use a fixed date. The rendered text should be the formatted current date and the `datetime` attribute should use the ISO date helper. Follow the existing feature and slot contract; do not add or rename slots and do not edit shared UI or date-library files.
deliverables: Header slot renders a `<time>` element with formatted today's date
`src/features/header-date/index.test.ts` covering fixed-date formatting and mounted output
definitionOfDone: New test calls `formatHeaderDate(new Date(2025, 0, 2))` and asserts the exact fixed formatted output from `src/lib/dates.ts`
New mount test asserts the header slot contains a `<time>` element whose text equals `formatHeaderDate(new Date())`

tasks.title: Add distinct-tag count footer note
tasks.goal: Create a new feature folder `src/features/tag-count` that exports a `defineFeature` module. Subscribe to the `TodoStore` through `FeatureContext`, compute the number of distinct normalized tags across all todos using the existing tag-normalization behavior in `src/store/todos.ts`, and render a footer note such as `3 tags in use` or `1 tag in use` into the documented footer slot. Update the note after additions, edits, and removals. Do not edit shared registry, render, slot, store, or global style files.
deliverables: Footer slot renders singular/plural distinct-tag count text
`src/features/tag-count/index.test.ts` covering duplicate tags and store updates
definitionOfDone: New test with tags `work`, `work`, `home`, and `errand` asserts the footer text is `3 tags in use`
Adding a new tag `urgent` updates the footer to `4 tags in use`, and adding another duplicate `home` leaves it at `4 tags in use`

tasks.title: Cover tab title, header date, and footer tag count together
tasks.goal: Add a new top-level integration test at `src/features/display-integration.test.ts` that uses the existing DOM/test harness to boot or mount the app with deterministic todos. Assert that the tab title shows the open-task count, the header shows today's formatted date, and the footer shows the distinct-tag count at the same time. Then mutate the store and assert all relevant displays update. Do not modify feature implementations or shared files; this task only adds the integration test file.
deliverables: `src/features/display-integration.test.ts` integration test covering all three display behaviors together
definitionOfDone: New test boots the app with 2 open todos and 1 completed todo using tags `work`, `home`, and `work`, then asserts title contains `2 open`, footer contains `2 tags in use`, and header contains `formatHeaderDate(new Date())`
After completing one open todo, test asserts title contains `1 open`; after adding a new open todo tagged `urgent`, test asserts title contains `2 open` and footer contains `3 tags in use`
No feature implementation or shared file is modified

Feature modules use the existing `FeatureContext` and slot registry; shared files such as `src/features/index.ts`, `src/features/registry.ts`, `src/ui/slots.ts`, `src/ui/render.ts`, and `src/store/todos.ts` are read-only unless a task explicitly owns them.
Todo data comes from `createTodoStore`; subscribe for changes and never mutate store internals directly.
Use existing `src/lib/dates.ts` formatting helpers rather than locale-dependent `toLocaleDateString`.
Feature styles must be colocated CSS inside the feature folder with unique class names; do not edit `src/ui/styles.css`.
No network access, credentials, secrets, or packages not already present in `package.json`.
